purpose: Findings listed here are intentionally visible in release evidence and are not supply-chain allowlist suppressions. Pattern adopted from TableTheory's gov-infra/planning/theorydb-visible-npm-audit-findings.json (operator decision 2026-08-03).

findings.remove_when: Remove this entry and close the exception as soon as a released aws-cdk-lib bundles brace-expansion 5.0.9 or newer; upgrade aws-cdk-lib in the same change. Dependabot keeps the alert open on the default branch until then.
findings.justification: Advisory published 2026-08-03 (DoS via unbounded intermediate arrays, bypassing the CVE-2026-14257 mitigation); brace-expansion >=4.0.0 <5.0.9 vulnerable, patched only in 5.0.9. aws-cdk-lib 2.263.0 is the latest release (AppTheory pinned peer) and bundles brace-expansion 5.0.8 inside its published tarball — verified by direct tarball inspection. npm overrides cannot replace bundled dependencies — verified empirically 2026-08-03 (override of brace-expansion@5.0.9 leaves the bundled 5.0.8 in place and audit red). No released aws-cdk-lib carries the fix, so no workaround exists. The affected minimatch path runs only while synthesizing fixed-input infrastructure (cdk synth/test at build time) and is not shipped in Lambda assets. Keep the advisory visible in RELEASE-ASSETS evidence and re-review or remove this exception by the expiry date.
